# read-only: is the JAX virtualenv on $WORK still there, which versions, does it see the GPU
function esc(s)
    s = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => "\\t")
    return "\"" * s * "\""
end
function sh(cmd)
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    try
        run(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -c $cmd`), stdout = out, stderr = err))
    catch e
        return "ERROR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
    end
    return String(take!(out)) * (position(err) > 0 ? "\n[stderr]\n" * first(String(take!(err)), 1500) : "")
end
